title: Detect champion-leaving signals in call transcripts
item: One sentence from a call transcript or email
questions: noul:champion_at_risk - does the speaker hint they are leaving, being reorganized, or losing budget authority; choice:topic - [job_change,reorg,budget_cut,none]
action: Flag deal in CRM, create a multithread task, alert AE when probability>0.8
why_jev: Cheap per-sentence scan of every call; regex cannot catch "my role is getting folded into ops"

title: Spot buying-committee roles from email signatures and replies
item: One contact's title plus their last email
action: Fill buying-committee map; show missing roles per deal and prompt AE
why_jev: Title strings are wildly inconsistent; semantic mapping beats a title regex

title: Does this inbound reply mean "not now" versus "never"
item: One prospect reply to a cold sequence
questions: choice:intent - [not_now,never,wrong_person,interested,ooo,insufficient_context]; noul:names_referral - does the reply name another person
action: Route: not_now to nurture 90 days, never to suppress, wrong_person to referral task
why_jev: Reply triage at sequence scale; decision is shallow and reversible, LLM only writes the follow-up

title: Pre-send guard on outbound email claims
questions: noul:unapproved_claim - does it promise pricing, discounts, legal terms, or roadmap dates; noul:competitor_disparagement - does it attack a competitor
action: Block send and show reason if either true with confidence>0.6
why_jev: Runs on every send in milliseconds; an LLM gate adds latency and cost per email

title: Score MEDDICC completeness per deal note
action: Combine into deal-health score; surface the weakest dimension to the manager in pipeline review
why_jev: Turns free-text notes into structured fields without forcing reps to fill forms

title: Detect hidden pricing objection in discovery calls
questions: noul:price_objection - is the buyer pushing back on cost, even politely; choice:style - [direct,hedged,comparison_to_competitor,budget_timing,none]
action: Tag timestamp in call library; build objection frequency dashboard by segment
why_jev: Polite objections evade keyword search; segment-level scale makes LLM costly

title: Match inbound lead company to ICP tiers from website blurb
action: Set lead score tier and route to SDR queue or nurture
why_jev: Firmographic APIs miss niche model; fast enough to run at form-submit

title: Classify why a closed-lost deal was lost from loss notes
action: Reclassify the messy picklist; feed win/loss dashboard and spot reason drift by quarter
why_jev: Reps pick "other" 40% of the time; cheap relabel of the whole history

title: Detect forecast-sandbagging language in rep commentary
questions: score:confidence_tone - [defensive,neutral,confident]; noul:contradicts_stage - does the comment contradict the stage selected
action: Highlight mismatches to RevOps; compare tone to historical close rates
why_jev: Semantic mismatch detection between prose and structured fields at scale

title: Next-best-action routing for stalled opportunities
item: Last three activity summaries on a stalled deal
action: Pick a playbook template by cause and create a task
why_jev: Turns activity logs into a routing key; the LLM only drafts after the cause is known

title: Is this renewal email a real escalation
item: One inbound email in an account's thread
questions: noul:escalation - is the sender threatening to churn, cancel, or go to legal; score:urgency - [low,med,high]
action: Page the account owner and open a save-play ticket if high
why_jev: Seconds-latency triage on all inbound mail; false negatives caught by thresholds

title: Dedupe accounts by semantic identity not name
item: Pair of account records (name, domain, description)
action: Auto-merge same with confidence>0.95; queue parent_child for hierarchy; leave others
why_jev: Fuzzy string matching creates false merges on "Acme Health" vs "Acme Healthcare Ltd"

title: Territory-fit check for lead assignment
item: One lead with free-text region and vertical info
action: Assign by territory when sure; unclear goes to ops queue
why_jev: Messy free-text locations ("Bay-ish", "remote in EU")

title: Which compliance paragraph does this security-questionnaire row match
action: Auto-fill the approved answer if confidence>0.85; none goes to security team
why_jev: Retrieval over a small curated menu; no generation, so no hallucinated compliance claims

title: Detect competitor mentions and sentiment in call snippets
action: Update battlecard hit counts; alert PMM when new unfavorable mentions spike
why_jev: Runs on every call minute; cheap enough that a keyword list is no longer needed

title: Quote-approval triage by discount rationale
action: Auto-approve standard small discounts; escalate pressure_tactic or unsupported
why_jev: Approval queues stall; semantic gating fast and consistent

title: Cluster outbound sequence replies into messaging winners
action: Attribute reply to hook; cost per hook; promote winning hooks
why_jev: Reply-level attribution without human coding

title: Detect inaccurate CRM stage by comparing notes to stage definitions
item: Latest note plus current stage name
action: Flag where implied stage differs by 2+ from actual; send to rep
why_jev: Continuous pipeline hygiene without nagging reps for forms

title: Identify ghosted prospects who actually replied on another channel
item: Slack, LinkedIn, or email snippet tied to an open deal
questions: noul:is_reply_to_outreach - is this a response to our sales outreach
action: Reopen deal, pause sequence automatically
why_jev: Joins channels semantically where IDs do not match

title: Churn-risk language in support ticket threads
item: One customer message in a ticket
action: Add to health score; page CSM on strong or vendor mention
why_jev: Every message scanned; LLM per message is cost-prohibitive at volume

title: Is this QBR agenda item a risk or an expansion signal
item: One bullet from a QBR notes doc
action: Auto-sort notes into risk and expansion lists on the account page
why_jev: Cheap structure for unstructured notes

title: Detect "silent churn" in NPS verbatims
questions: noul:disengaged - does the tone indicate indifference rather than satisfaction; choice:cause - [value_gap,missing_feature,support,price,none]
action: Trigger a CSM check-in for disengaged passives
why_jev: Passives hide risk; semantic read of tone beyond the number

title: Classify onboarding-stall reason from customer email
action: Route to matching playbook and set follow-up timer
why_jev: Routing key on every inbound; LLM writes later

title: Match customer goals to product features
item: One customer stated goal from kickoff notes
action: Build per-account adoption plan; compute adoption gap by area
why_jev: Menu-constrained mapping keeps plans consistent across CSMs

title: Is this customer ready for a case study ask
item: Last ten messages from a customer plus health metrics summary
questions: noul:advocate_ready - warm tone, achieved results, no open issues
action: Add to advocacy list; CSM approves ask
why_jev: Finds quiet promoters buried in threads

title: Detect executive-sponsor change in customer meetings
questions: noul:sponsor_change - is a new senior stakeholder introduced or an existing one departing
action: Update stakeholder map; trigger intro task
why_jev: Many weak signals across thousands of notes

title: Sort in-app feedback widget comments by actionable intent
action: Route to support, product feedback board, or help docs; hide spam
why_jev: High volume low value; fast routing without reading

title: Which help article would resolve this customer question
action: Show the article inline if confidence>0.8; else forward to agent
why_jev: 100 ms suggestion fits typing time; no generation required

title: Detect contract-renewal risk phrases in procurement emails
action: Create renewal risk task with due date
why_jev: Procurement jargon is subtle; direct classification catches phrases keyword lists miss

title: Triage CSM handoff notes for completeness
item: One handoff note from sales to CS
action: Bounce incomplete handoffs back to AE before kickoff
why_jev: Three atomic checks, combined in code

title: Detect usage-drop explanation from customer reply to nudge email
item: One reply to a low-usage nudge
action: Tag the account; choose playbook
why_jev: Cheap cause attribution for reply streams

title: Is this renewal discussion price-driven or value-driven
action: Prepare the right renewal narrative template
why_jev: Classify first, then use the matching LLM-written plan

title: Spot expansion intents in support tickets
questions: noul:expansion_signal - is the customer asking to add seats, regions, or capabilities; choice:what - [seats,module,integration,none]
action: Create an expansion lead for AE with context link
why_jev: Support is a rich expansion source that sales never reads

title: Score customer email tone for escalating frustration across a thread
item: Last three messages in a thread
action: Alert team lead when rising across consecutive messages
why_jev: Trend not single message; cheap enough to run every reply

title: Detect a customer asking for something we cannot do by contract
questions: noul:out_of_scope - is it outside the support or service agreement
action: Hand to account manager as a billable scope request
why_jev: Scope creep leak plug at message time

title: Auto-prioritize an incoming ticket by blast radius language
action: Boost priority for whole_account; page on-call on multi_account

title: Detect duplicate or incident-related tickets
action: Link duplicates; if 5+ same_issue in 10 minutes, open incident
why_jev: Pairwise cost is the whole issue with LLM; Jev makes pair loops affordable

title: Is this ticket a refund request in disguise
action: Route to billing with priority if wants_refund; legal if threat
why_jev: Never says "refund": "I want my money back" and "I will dispute this charge"

title: Detect PII or secrets pasted into support tickets
questions: noul:contains_secret - does it include an API key, password, or card number context
action: Redact attachment, warn agent, mask in logs
why_jev: Regex misses context; semantic cue combined with regex for facts

title: Pick the right macro for an agent reply
action: Pre-select macro in agent UI; agent edits
why_jev: Menu-constrained; none avoids bad suggestions

title: Spot machine-translated or garbled tickets needing a language route
action: Route to translation tool or multilingual agent
why_jev: Language ID tools miss garbled mixed text

title: Is this agent draft reply safe to send
item: One agent or bot draft reply plus ticket summary
questions: noul:makes_promise - does it promise a refund, date, or fix; noul:blames_customer; noul:answers_the_question
action: Block or flag; require supervisor if promise made without authority
why_jev: Per-message guard at every send; lower latency than LLM review

title: Detect "customer is not really asking a question" tickets
action: Skip knowledge-base search for rants; route rants to empathetic macro
why_jev: Saves wasted retrieval and cost

title: Cluster tickets by root cause during a spike
item: One ticket during a spike window
action: Count per hypothesis on a live dashboard; alert on "new" cluster growth
why_jev: Live triage while an incident unfolds

title: Is the bot stuck in a loop with the customer
item: Last four turns of a chatbot conversation
action: Hand off to a human immediately
why_jev: Every turn, instant; the control loop never waits on an LLM

title: Identify tickets where the answer is already in the previous reply
item: Customer follow-up plus previous agent reply
questions: noul:ignored_prior_answer - did customer miss info given before
action: Offer a polite pointer macro; reduce handle time
why_jev: Cheap detection of reading failure

title: Detect abuse or harassment toward agents
action: Allow agent to disengage; escalate threats to security
why_jev: Protects staff; every message, every time

title: Classify CSAT free text into fixable causes
action: Aggregate for coaching and policy reviews
why_jev: Cheap relabel of years of comments

title: Does this ticket need a screenshot or logs before first reply
questions: noul:needs_artifacts - cannot be diagnosed without logs or screenshot
action: Auto-reply requesting artifacts; hold ticket until received
why_jev: Saves a round trip

title: Judge KB article freshness against recent tickets
item: Pair: article summary and a recent ticket resolution
action: Flag article for review when 3+ contradictions appear
why_jev: Pairwise at scale finds stale docs

title: Gate escalation to engineering for completeness
action: Bounce incomplete escalations to tier two with checklist

title: Triage app-store reviews to the right team

title: Is this feature request a duplicate of an existing roadmap item

title: Is the user asking for a solution or describing a problem

title: Gate release notes drafts against internal leaks

title: Spot churn-reason themes in cancellation survey

title: Match launch support questions to launch FAQ

title: Is this usability-test moment a struggle

title: Dedupe insights across studies

title: Screen survey open-text responses for low-effort answers

why_jev: Protects panel quality without manual review

title: Screener fit for participant recruiting
action: Accept, waitlist or reject automatically; flag patterns

title: Detect participant discomfort in research sessions

why_jev: Ethics support at human speed

title: Classify mental-model mismatches in card-sort comments
action: Cluster rationale types to inform IA
why_jev: Open-text rationales become structured data

title: Does this support chat reveal a navigation failure

why_jev: Mines support for UX research for free
